opening.argument: The offer presents an unusually high-value reward as immediately available: the frame promises “Get a FREE $1,000” Best Buy gift card, while another directs viewers to “CLICK HERE NOW.” The description turns that promise into a solicitation, instructing viewers, “Visit: http://goo.gl/HFIAHR TO GET YOUR FREE BEST BUY GIFTCARD!!!” and linking the claim to email registration: “Sign Up With Your Email And You'll Be On Your Way To Getting A Free Best Buy Gift Card!!!” Repeated gift-card graphics and directions to visit the link reinforce the acquisition pitch. The supplied material does not establish the destination's behavior, any Best Buy affiliation, successful email submission, or delivery of the gift card, but it does establish the low-barrier reward solicitation.
